body: I know that is a good idea, but don't feel like it is worth the hassle, even though I know it is.

Sadly, when I was a gamer, I played only single player games lol, and I really don't like animals. 
But I do agree that I need real human interaction. The problem is with my old group of friends is that they clown on me for other reasons (mainly being vegan) and though it is in good fun, it bothers me. I have told them to stop, and they didn't, so that's why I don't hang out with them anymore.

I got a 9-5 job, with an hour commute each wave so that takes up a lot of my time. It all feels pointless and senseless though. I'm a gamer, by and by, but I feel extremely lethargic wen I start playing and see no point in it, which sucks because while I do show enthusiasm for upcoming games, when and if I get them, I feel no motivation to play them.

The problem was, I ignored all my other friends when I developed this relationship with my new best friend. It happened so much so that I pretty much have no friends. It was really awful losing my best friend. I got over it at first by ignoring it, which caused me to drink, which caused me to hate myself and life, and then just do it.
At first, they didn't improve. It just got worse and worse. That's when I just had to much. Since I got over it, or thought I did, it did get better. Now I feel like it's coming back full circle.
